summary: SectionTitle renders a section heading made of an 'ARKNIGHTS ENDFIELD' wordmark SVG (viewBox 0 0 122 6), an arrow block (23x23 arrow icon plus the English title, which is hidden when lang is en-us) and a Chinese/localised title whose lines are split on newline unless keepTitlePC (landscape) or keepTitleH5 (portrait) asks to keep it whole. Once the element is in view (useInView once) and, when loadingEable is true, the LoadingScreen store reports loaded, it fires TextRevealAnimations.zI flicker reveals on the EN title after 400ms and on the CN title after 600ms. Props also accept theme (default 'light', mapped to a CSS-module class), className, style and titleClassName.
